Subtracting 227 days from 1767-03-04:  
1767 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
March 4 minus 227 days: back 4 days → Feb 28, back 223 more days → 223 days before Feb 28.  
223 days before Feb 28 = 223 - 31 (Jan) = 192 days left in previous year.  
192 days before Jan 1, 1767 = 192 days into 1766 from the end: 365 - 192 = day 173 of 1766.  
Day 173 in 1766 = June 22 (31+28+31+30+31+22=173).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1766-06-22
